steps.title: Coat coverslips with poly‑L‑lysine
steps.instruction: Place 2–3 sterile coverslips in each 35 mm dish, add enough 0.01 % poly‑L‑lysine (PLL) to cover the surface, and incubate 30 min at room temperature (RT). Remove PLL and briefly rinse coverslips with sterile water.

steps.title: Seed HEK293T cells on coated coverslips
steps.instruction: Culture HEK293T T/17 cells in DMEM supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS), 1 % penicillin, and 1 % streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified. Grow to confluence, then detach cells with 0.25 % trypsin (prepare 10 mL: 9 mL serum‑free DMEM + 1 mL 2.5 % trypsin), incubate 10 min at 37 °C. Transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge 1 500 × g for 10 min at RT, discard supernatant, resuspend in 5–10 mL serum‑free DMEM, count cells, and plate 450 000 cells onto each PLL‑coated coverslip. Add 2 mL DMEM with 10 % FBS and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Transfect cells with Cx36 vector
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours after seeding, remove media, wash cells briefly with serum‑free DMEM, then add 900 µL serum‑free DMEM and return to the incubator. Prepare transfection mix: Mix A – 5 µL Geneporter 2 + 43 µL serum‑free DMEM; Mix B – 1 µg Cx36 expression vector + 50 µL DNA diluent (Diluent A or B). Combine Mix A and Mix B, incubate 15 min at RT. Apply the mixture to the cells and incubate 2 h at 37 °C. After 2 h, add 1 mL of DMEM containing 20 % FBS and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Fix cells for immunostaining
steps.instruction: Nineteen to twenty‑four hours post‑transfection, transfer coverslips to a 24‑well plate, wash briefly with PBS, then fix in 2 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 15 min at RT. Wash 3 × 10 min with PBS at RT.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody solution in PBS containing 0.5 % Triton‑X 100 and 10 % normal donkey serum (NDS): Cx36 antibody 1:500. For double‑labeling, add Tex264 antibody 1:200 and Golgin97 antibody 1:100. Apply enough solution to cover each coverslip and incubate overnight at RT.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: The next day, wash coverslips 3 × 10 min with PBS. Prepare secondary antibody in PBS with 0.5 % Triton‑X 100 and 10 % NDS: Cy3‑conjugated donkey anti‑mouse (or anti‑rabbit as appropriate). For double‑labeling, use Alexa 488‑conjugated secondary for Tex264/Golgin97. Incubate 1 h at RT in the dark.

steps.title: Mount coverslips for microscopy
steps.instruction: Wash 3 × 10 min with PBS at RT, then place 5 µL of Vectashield PLUS mounting medium containing DAPI on an object slide. Invert the coverslip (cell side down) onto the drop, seal edges with nail polish, and store protected from light.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Image stained cells on a confocal laser‑scanning microscope (e.g., Zeiss LSM800) using a 63× oil immersion objective. Detect Cy3 (Cx36) and DAPI. Set zoom to 2–3×, pixel size ≈ 50 nm × 50 nm, and acquire Z‑stacks with 0.2 µm spacing. Capture a sufficient number of cells per experimental condition.

steps.title: Measure whorl diameter in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Open each stack in ImageJ (Fiji). Use the rectangular selection tool to outline a Cx36 whorl, duplicate the ROI (Shift + D), draw a straight line across the whorl with the line tool, and record the length via Measure (Ctrl + M).

steps.title: Set size threshold and count whorls
steps.instruction: Based on measurements, set a diameter threshold of 0.3 µm to exclude smaller vesicles. Open the Cell Counter plugin, click ‘Initialize’, choose a counter type, and count whorls in each stack by left‑clicking each qualifying vesicle. Record the number of whorls per cell for downstream analysis.
